attitude_reference_trained.ned_mapping: roll_up = roll_ned, pitch_up = -pitch_ned, yaw_up = -yaw_ned (C = diag(1,-1,-1), as q_est)
attitude_reference_trained.q_des_convention: (w,x,y,z) body FLU -> world z-up, quat_from_euler_xyz(roll_up, pitch_up, yaw_up) = Rz Ry Rx; FLU pitch + = nose DOWN

meta.axes_note: NO axes, NO s/t: 8 pulses on RC_CHANNELS_OVERRIDE ch 9..16 (Lua override); roll/pitch are commanded THROUGH the pulses, the reference rides q_des (plan roll/pitch clipped to the trained envelope)
meta.cap_note: scale: one scalar on the thrust vector (rl_pwm.scale_throttles), max|throttle| at the cap, direction kept; clip: per-thruster clip (A/B only). A pulse beyond the cap is refused (neutral + n_fail), never clipped — REPORT 2026-10-10 §1 cause 4

heave_trim.csv_note: the CSV (workers.py schema <= 23) has NO column for the policy's own part, pwm_scale or the trim: on a run with heave_trim_n != 0, pwm1..8 (the vehicle's SERVO_OUTPUT_RAW) and uX..uN are policy + trim — never read them as the policy's actions and never pool the run with untrimmed ones; this block's counts / delivered are the only per-engagement record

delivered.note: over this engagement's trimmed ticks: the wrench the trim added on top of the policy's own part (nominal model of the throttles, the uX..uN convention; the edge quantization and the cap scale included) against the pure heave asked for (-trim cos roll cos pitch, zero moment) — a model number, NOT a measurement

heave_trim.note: physical N, + = UP in the world (obs_guard.hold_wrench_z_n is NED: the same thrust model, the opposite sign), the export's nominal thrust model (T200 x voltage_scale); per tick world-up is rotated into the body frame by the ESTIMATED roll/pitch and allocated minimum-norm over thrusters 5..8 (rl_pwm.heave_trim_thrust, the HOLD's allocation — a zero-moment heave REQUEST, the tilted part of world-up dropped), added in thrust space, then the cap on the TOTAL (rl_pwm.trim_and_cap); the delivered wrench is that pure heave only where every vertical total clears its deadband edge — a total inside the gap leaves AT the edge (counts.ticks_edge; at_rest = the pattern with the policy's verticals at rest); a trim above cap_budget.limit of one vertical's capped range is refused at build; prev_action = the policy's own part after the same scale; the HOLD pulses are never trimmed. thrust_level_* / wrench_ned_level = the request at level attitude. 0 = off (the code path of before). NEVER FLOWN [예측]
